sloka: ते हया मथिता भग्ना व्यसवो धरणीं गताः।ते निहत्य हयांस्तस्य प्रमथ्य च महारथम् ।। ६.९०.५२ ।।
transliteration: te hayā mathitā bhagnā vyasavo dharaṇīṁ gatāḥ।te nihatya hayāṁstasya pramathya ca mahāratham ।। 6.90.52 ।।

translations.english: The horses were mutilated, broken, and sunk into the earth and killed. Again, bounding the great chariot, they got up quickly and stood nearby Lakshmana.
